methodology: Detailed support ledger for the authoritative standing material-loss and separate munitions-expenditure envelopes in iran-loss-envelopes.json. Direct contracts are preferred; where unavailable, contemporary capability analogues, composition scenarios and defensible damage-severity assumptions are permitted with assumptions exposed. Hypothetical future repair/reconstitution spending is outside canonical current-loss accounting.

asset_records.loss_status: DESTROYED/SUNK — high confidence for one boat
asset_records.basis_note: Washington Post cited U.S. intelligence estimate of $600M for two submarines.
asset_records.method: Historical acquisition cost adjusted to 2026 CPI; purchasing-power proxy, not a current Kilo replacement quote.
exclusions: Modern shipyard, weapons, support, sanctions and replacement-lead-time premiums.

asset_records.loss_status: At least two, likely three destroyed at Isfahan in commercial imagery review
asset_records.basis_note: $1.8B for 80 Iranian F-14s, missiles excluded; simple average $22.5M.
asset_records.method: Historical F-14 acquisition cost adjusted to 2026 CPI; floor uses two observed losses, central/high use three probable losses.
exclusions: Irreplaceability/obsolescence premium, spares scarcity and restoration costs.

asset_records.loss_status: Destroyed at Tabriz in Israeli strike report
asset_records.basis_note: State Department FMS estimated flyaway price range around Dec 1970.
asset_records.method: Historical acquisition cost adjusted to 2026 CPI.
exclusions: Modern capability replacement and sustainment scarcity.

asset_records.loss_status: Two F-5 aircraft reported destroyed at Tabriz; exact variant/operational status uncertainty is handled by range rather than deferring price
asset_records.basis_note: Historical Iranian F-5A grant average. 2026 destroyed aircraft may be other F-5 variants and some parked airframes may have been non-operational.
exclusions: Ahvaz F-5/F-27 parked-aircraft bucket beyond the two Tabriz F-5s
asset_records.method: Two-aircraft scenario. Low uses existing CPI-adjusted historical Iranian F-5A proxy ($6.215M each); central/high use $10M/$15M legacy-fighter capability bands to cover variant and condition uncertainty.

infrastructure_records.physical_damage: Major vessel losses plus base/shipyard damage and blocked berths documented in CSIS imagery analysis.
infrastructure_records.method: Civil/port/shipyard shell and utilities proxy. World Bank quay reconstruction benchmark and Iran-local shell rates bound civil works; specialty shipyard machinery is excluded to INDUSTRIAL_PRODUCTION.

infrastructure_records.physical_damage: CSIS reports roughly 40% of harbor basin destroyed and much of the primary quay damaged/destroyed.
infrastructure_records.method: Port civil-work analogue. Karachi Port project reconstructed 922m of quay/berths for $112.6M in 2010 project terms; range expands around that anchor for basin damage, utilities and wartime reconstruction uncertainty.

infrastructure_records.site: Khojir and other missile/UAS production building shells
infrastructure_records.physical_damage: Open imagery and campaign reporting show major structural damage at multiple weapon-production sites.
infrastructure_records.method: Structural shell/civil-only class proxy using Iran-local public construction rates and multi-site damage; specialized machinery/tooling is separately modeled in INDUSTRIAL_PRODUCTION.

infrastructure_records.site: Fath Air Base / Valiasr / Ashura and other airbase/security shells
infrastructure_records.physical_damage: Open Sentinel/Bellingcat comparisons document damaged/destroyed structures across airbase/security facilities.
infrastructure_records.method: Building-shell/runway/hangar/utilities class proxy, not site-by-site quantity survey. Bellingcat incident set and Iran-local shell rates bound the aggregate.

construction_shell_model.local_basis: Iran 1405 public/government-style project benchmark from Haft Shahr Aria; excludes specialized equipment

fx_sensitivity_reference.warning: Exchange-rate source is indicative and the Iranian wartime currency is distorted; do not present converted shell costs as audited replacement cost.

construction_shell_model.use_rule: If a damage polygon or defensible destroyed floor/footprint area is available, multiply area by the appropriate shell-only rate and present as STRUCTURAL_SHELL_ONLY. Do not add missile-production machinery, classified electronics, stockpiles, tunnels, utilities or remediation without separate evidence.

explicit_exclusions: Human casualties, including leadership deaths, are not monetized.
Macroeconomic losses, GDP, oil revenue, sanctions, trade disruption and opportunity costs.
Civilian/private property not captured in military fixed-site models.
Strategic value, deterrence value, sanctions-induced procurement premium and time-to-reconstitute are not converted into dollars.
Munitions expenditure is reported separately from destroyed material inventory.
Hypothetical future repair/reconstitution or capability-restoration spending.

capability_replacement_analogues.use_rule: Upper-capability analogue for Iranian frigate/corvette replacement; not a direct valuation of older Iranian hulls. Iranian corvette bands below the Gowind analogue are explicit analyst discounts, not sourced contract prices.

capability_replacement_analogues.description: Modern missile-armed fast multi-role attack craft
capability_replacement_analogues.use_rule: Capability analogue only; Iranian FAC classes vary substantially. Central/high are analyst bands to cover larger combat systems and are not source contract prices.

capability_replacement_analogues.low_usd_equivalent_basis: $50M analyst conservative lower capability band below the new-build compact-submarine program analogue
capability_replacement_analogues.central_usd_equivalent_basis: $100M analyst midpoint between SDV-type and new compact attack submarine
capability_replacement_analogues.high_usd_equivalent_basis: ~$233M program-average for six DRASS DGK compact submarines with training/logistics
capability_replacement_analogues.use_rule: Use for non-Kilo coastal/midget submarine envelope only; $50M low and $100M central are explicit analyst bands below the ~$233M program-average high analogue; excludes the separately priced Kilo.
Use only for Shahed-class/simple one-way attack UAVs, not jet-powered or larger UAVs.
Broad mix range. Exclude unidentified higher-cost systems from central; disclose mix uncertainty.

capability_replacement_analogues.historical_basis: Five battalions/systems worth >$800M; >$160M each nominal contract floor
capability_replacement_analogues.use_rule: Historical Iran-specific floor; central/high apply analyst current-capability bands rather than treating nominal 2007 dollars as current replacement quote.

capability_replacement_analogues.historical_basis: 29 systems under $700M contract, about $24.1M each nominal
capability_replacement_analogues.use_rule: Iran-specific historical floor; central/high bands cover inflation/current replacement and integration uncertainty.

capability_replacement_analogues.historical_basis: FY2023 recurring launcher unit cost ~$5.625M; gross weapon-system unit cost ~$6.77M
capability_replacement_analogues.use_rule: Upper-capability anchor only. Iranian ballistic TELs are modeled at $2M/$4M/$6M to avoid importing full U.S. system cost.

capability_replacement_analogues.historical_basis: $100M, 320,000 sq ft C2 headquarters supporting up to 1,500 personnel
capability_replacement_analogues.use_rule: High-end physical C2 analogue. C2 category prices mission-system/secure fitout only so building shell is not double-counted.

capability_replacement_analogues.historical_basis: $112.6M for 922m of quay/berth reconstruction at Karachi Port, 2010 project terms
capability_replacement_analogues.use_rule: Bounds civil/port reconstruction; not Iranian labor-rate or wartime-specific quote.

capability_replacement_analogues.historical_basis: $74M FY2025 MILCON facility plus $21.742M installed equipment other appropriation
capability_replacement_analogues.use_rule: Process-line/machinery capability benchmark; Iranian line-equivalent scenarios are deliberately broad and shells are priced separately.

legacy_superseded_subset_snapshot.purpose: Lineage/backward compatibility only. These values predate the completed category envelopes and are not a current floor, subtotal, estimate, or total.

legacy_values.scope: One U.S.-attributed Kilo loss + two confirmed/three probable Israeli-attributed F-14 losses + one Israeli-attributed F-4 loss. This is a tiny mixed-attribution subset, not Iran’s total war loss.
legacy_values.warning: Do not use this legacy subset as any current Iran cost figure. Use iran-loss-envelopes.json for authoritative standing material-loss and munitions-expenditure envelopes.

legacy_superseded_subset_snapshot.hard_rule: Downstream implementation must not surface, sum, label or infer the legacy $1.051B-$1.204B range as a current total, floor, subtotal, central estimate, or upper envelope.
legacy_superseded_subset_snapshot.display_label: LEGACY PARTIAL SUBSET — ARCHIVAL / BACKWARD-COMPATIBILITY ONLY

munitions_expenditure_separate.narrower_subset_rule: Archive/lineage analytical subset only; not the low bound of the all-region munitions envelope.
